Fabulous vibrant bar !!
Aug 2024 • Friends
Love this fantastic trendy, vibrant bar. Friendly professional staff, great cocktails, good wine at reasonable prices & craft beers served very cold. Yummy bar snacks, pizza, fish & chips & more. Also perfect for a late night bite. Live music 3 nights a week. Have now been living in Danang for 3 months & decided this is my go to bar for a fabulous experience all round !!

Now opened for breakfast (open atm weekends for breakfast but 7 days a week end August) tried the Avocado on toast, Eggs Benedict and Smoothie bowls. All delicious.
